The twelve Units of Klasse 11 (E) across the school
year. Each Unit covers roughly three teaching weeks.

| Unit | Title | Skills focus | Exam type |
|------|-------|--------------|-----------|
| 1 | [British Cultural Anchors](units/unit01_british-cultural-anchors.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | Klausur (assessment) |
| 2 | [The American Dream](units/unit02_the-american-dream.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | Klausur (assessment) |
| 3 | [Post-Colonial Voices: An Introduction](units/unit03_post-colonial-voices-intro.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | Klausur (assessment) |
| 4 | [Short Stories and Style](units/unit04_short-stories-and-style.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | Klausur (assessment) |
| 5 | [Poetry from the Anthology](units/unit05_poetry-from-the-anthology.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | Klausur (assessment) |
| 6 | [Media Literacy, Advanced](units/unit06_media-literacy-advanced.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | Klausur (assessment) |
| 7 | [Mediation as a Skill](units/unit07_mediation-as-a-skill.qmd) | mediation, writing, language_awareness | Klausur (assessment) |
| 8 | [Opinion Essay Writing](units/unit08_opinion-essay-writing.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | Klausur (assessment) |
| 9 | [A Modern Novel (Basisfach focus)](units/unit09_a-modern-novel-bf.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | Klausur (assessment) |
| 10 | [A Classic Text (Leistungsfach focus)](units/unit10_a-classic-text-lf.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | Klausur (assessment) |
| 11 | [Public Speaking: Toward the Komm-Prüfung](units/unit11_public-speaking-prep.qmd) | speaking, listening, language_awareness | Klausur (assessment) |
| 12 | [Klausur Prep: Exam Rehearsal](units/unit12_klausur-prep-exam-rehearsal.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | Klausur (assessment) |
